listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About
Apsis Warp Lab turns compatible Rokid waveguide glasses into an audio-reactive spatial flight environment. Surrounding sound becomes luminous objects, trails, radar contacts, and cockpit instrumentation in real time.

## Key Features
- Directional audio visualization with stereo and mono fallback modes
- Persistent bearing radar with contact history and localization confidence
- Procedural stars, travelers, trails, echoes, ripples, and rare anomalies
- Artificial horizon with wrap-safe yaw, pitch, and roll smoothing
- Manual recentering and depth-separated parallax
- Guided eight-sector microphone calibration

## Privacy
Audio analysis runs locally on the glasses. The app does not request Internet access and does not record, retain, upload, transmit, or transcribe audio.

## Requirements
- Compatible Rokid RG-series waveguide glasses
- Microphone permission
- Game rotation vector / IMU support

## Notes
- This is an experimental Community Preview
- Do not use while driving or during safety-critical activities
- Stop using the display if it causes discomfort, disorientation, headache, or visual strain
- Independent community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Rokid

## Apsis Warp Lab v0.4.6 — Attitude & Depth

Community Preview for compatible Rokid RG-series waveguide glasses.

### What changed

- Corrected the fused IMU coordinate frame for the glasses' optical/display orientation
- Added wrap-safe yaw, pitch, and roll smoothing
- Strengthened the artificial horizon while preserving restrained self-leveling
- Added compact bank and pitch reference marks
- Added manual Recenter View control
- Increased parallax travel and widened depth separation while keeping the cockpit visually anchored
- Preserved the spatial-audio pipeline, directional calibration, Sonic Constellations, controls, and long-wear visual restraint
